articles.title: Sadie Sokolov, 74, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Sadie Sokolov for the many years of service to Upper Commons.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Upper Commons. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to St. Brendan’s Parish in his or her name.
Born in Upper Commons in the years after the war, Sadie Sokolov spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

articles.title: Upper Commons Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: The vote came after 32 residents spoke at Sunday’s session.
body: Residents of Upper Commons said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Public works estimates the work will take about 32 weeks once it starts in July. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

Councilmember Simone Demetriou asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $3,400. Residents of Upper Commons said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.
